ios.desc:
Ready to reset your life in 75 days?

75Me is a customizable 75 day reset challenge built to help you build discipline, track daily habits, stay accountable, and become your best self. Whether you want a hard challenge, a softer reset, or a personalized routine that fits your lifestyle, 75Me helps you create a plan and follow through every day.

Unlike one-size-fits-all challenge trackers, 75Me lets you build a reset around your goals. Track your habits, workouts, progress photos, routines, reading, nutrition goals, and personal growth in one place.

How 75Me Works:

1. Personalized Challenge Builder

Start with a simple questionnaire about your lifestyle, goals, and current habits. 75Me creates a custom 75 day program for your reset, with the option to follow a hard or soft version of the challenge.

2. Daily Habit Tracking

Stay consistent with a clear daily checklist. Track the actions that matter most, including workouts, reading, water, nutrition, routines, journaling, and self-improvement goals.

3. Progress Photos

Take a daily progress photo and see your transformation over time. Watch your discipline, fitness, confidence, and consistency build day by day.

4. Accountability Community

Join a supportive community focused on discipline, motivation, habit building, and personal growth. Get help with accountability, meal prep, routines, mindset, and staying locked in.

5. Book Library

Access a personalized library of book summaries designed to help you learn about leadership, discipline, growth, mindset, and self-improvement throughout your reset.

75Me is for anyone who wants to build better habits, reset their life, improve their fitness, stay disciplined, and complete a meaningful 75 day challenge.

Start your 75 day reset today.

75Me requires a subscription to access. Some parts of the app may require additional purchases. This app is meant for users 13+ years of age only.
